entities.summary: Sakari Lindfors is a Finnish former professional ice hockey player who played in the SM-liiga. He played for HIFK and had time abroad in Italian, Swedish and Austrian leagues. He was inducted into the Finnish Hockey Hall of Fame in 2005.
